about: Where Caputo's joints are, for tools/rig-quadruped.py. Each point is [across, up, forward] in metres, measured on the model once it faces straight ahead and stands on the ground: across is to his left, up is from the ground, forward is toward his nose. A shoulder blade runs from the shoulder up to just under the skin beside the top of the back. An ear runs from its base to its tip. "clips" changes a clip's numbers from the script's own: here the middle of the front paws' path in the walk and the run, in metres ahead of the middle of the body, which sits further back than the script's own because his front legs slope forward as he stands, and the middle of the hind paws' path in the run. "jaw" is the hinge and chin of his lower jaw and "mouth" the line of his closed mouth, back to front, measured with tools/joint-views.py for the rope clips (he catches a rope in his teeth); with "jaw_keeps_weights" only the head's share of the skin below that line goes to the jaw, so every other clip moves as before.
grips_about: He holds a fishing rod in his jaws. at is a point on the line of his closed mouth, rod the way that line runs (the rod runs along it, out between his front teeth) and reel straight down (the side the rod's reel hangs on), all in his head bone's own space. tools/rig-quadruped.py prints them from "mouth" above. The preview page draws the rod from them, and tools/preview/fishing-measure.mjs checks every frame of his fishing clips against them.
